subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for both the Google thinking-payload sanitizer and the Vertex ADC/nolyfill auth crash, or should maintainers split the ADC path after reviewing the sanitizer PR?
rationale: The linked PR covers only the sanitizer slice, while later comments and dependency/source checks point to a distinct ADC auth-stack failure; automation should not queue another fix until maintainers choose the tracker boundary and proof requirement.

options.title: Keep Canonical Until Live ADC Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical user-facing crash tracker until the sanitizer PR lands and a live Vertex ADC/service-account run proves whether the auth-stack failure remains.

options.title: Split ADC Into A Narrow Issue
options.body: Let the sanitizer PR cover this issue’s payload-wrapper slice and open or designate a separate ADC/gaxios/nolyfill tracker for service-account auth failures.

options.title: Close Only After Both Slices Are Proven
options.body: Do not close this issue until both the sanitizer behavior and the ADC/service-account path are proven fixed in current main or a shipped release.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Until Live ADC Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical user-facing crash tracker until the sanitizer PR lands and a live Vertex ADC/service-account run proves whether the auth-stack failure remains.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blamed merge commit owns both the shared wrapper and Vertex ADC transport lines on main, making @RomneyDa the best available routing candidate for the maintainer scope decision.
